checks.name: Cardinal / diagonal movement have identical speed; feet are a radius-10 circle
Auto-attack kills enemies, drops faith, picks up faith and opens a paused three-card upgrade
First upgrade occurs at approximately 15–25 seconds in five seeded introductory encounters
Shared damage applies exactly once to peers and does not recurse
All six attacks execute; moving aura expands; sleep heals then instantly stops when moving
Passive slow, magnet, cooldown and fever have measurable effects
Maxed abilities are excluded and all 6 attack / 4 passive slots obey their caps
All three evolutions flow through a defeated boss reward and replace the original slot
Evolved rocks bounce, giants fall, evolved share pulses and sleep uses its large barrier
Bosses spawn once at 3, 6 and 8 minutes, far from player, with a warning
Pause freezes simulation, enemy bullets and danger warnings
Defeating final boss wins; HP zero loses; retry removes every old entity and timer
Starting voice instantly kills opening clocks, with a wider three-shot fan
Early random choices always include an owned attack upgrade and a new direct attack
Rock impacts splash into neighboring enemies and create an impact effect
Sixty kills release a burst, clear bullets, collect faith and never recursively recharge themselves
Recovery pickups heal 24 and level ups heal 12
Long stationary sleep gets an avoidable warning rather than instant damage
Every minute raises enemy health and density without changing already spawned enemies
Elites are larger and resist knockback while taking the full attack damage
Threat transitions announce once, pause freezes them, and retry resets the tier
Mass kills cannot multiply healing drops without waiting for the recovery interval
Full-length eight-minute simulation reaches every boss without entity leaks
